title: Top product per category by revenue
statementMd:
For each category, show the product with the highest revenue (non-cancelled lines). Show category, product name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `category`, `name`, `revenue`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id), k AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk FROM r) SELECT category, name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM k WHERE rk = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
